title: 16mm Diagonal Light Leak
description: Full-frame warm emulsion leak with a diagonal exposure boundary and left-edge perforations. Other warm/red exposure frames from this scan pack are collapsed into this family. Original static 16mm film scan by Matthew Moloney // FilterGrade under CC BY 3.0. Attribution and full legal code are retained; the local JPEG preview is resized/reencoded without crop or contrast changes.
